input.command:
git add \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/env.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/route-registry.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/upload-handlers.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/app.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/api.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/cron/heartbeat-sweep.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/db/hyperdrive.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/shims/node-fs.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/shims/node-fs-promises.ts \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/.gitignore \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/.dev.vars.example \
  packages/deploy-cloudflare/wrangler.toml && \
git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
refactor(deploy-cloudflare): split api.ts into focused modules and fix connection pool

Split the 526-line api.ts into five focused files:
- env.ts: Env interface + resolveDeploymentMode() helper (eliminates 3x duplicated ternary)
- route-registry.ts: all 22 route imports + buildRequestResources() + path regex cache
- upload-handlers.ts: R2 upload endpoints, registered separately from the API catch-all
- app.ts: Hono app, setup gate, middleware, and /api/* catch-all
- api.ts: thin entry point (~100 lines) — fetch, queue, cron, DO/Workflow re-exports

Also fixes:
- Hyperdrive pool max: 5 → 1 (each pool is created per-request and never closed)
- Remove dead getCompiledRoutes wrapper and unused skillsService/instructionsService
- Update heartbeat-sweep.ts Env import to env.ts
- Remove duplicate notAvailableSync in node-fs.ts
- Fix node-fs-promises.ts default export (add lstat, watch, pipeline)
- Add .gitignore (excludes dist/ and .dev.vars) and .dev.vars.example
- Bump wrangler.toml compatibility_date to 2025-03-01

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
input.description: Stage and commit the refactoring changes
